edit.statement: In every Legal Entity Identifier (LEI), the first four characters identify the Local Operating Unit (LOU) that issued it.
edit.subject: A Legal Entity Identifier
edit.scope: The meaning of the four-character prefix of LEIs under ISO 17442; the other characters are left aside.

direct.prompt: What do the first four characters of every Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) identify?
direct.new_answer: the Local Operating Unit (LOU) that issued it

paraphrase.prompt: In an LEI code, what does the four-character prefix tell you?
paraphrase.new_answer: which Local Operating Unit issued the LEI

cross_lingual.prompt: 每个法人机构识别编码（LEI）的前四个字符代表什么？
cross_lingual.new_answer: 签发该编码的本地运营机构（LOU）

cross_lingual.prompt: ¿Qué identifican los cuatro primeros caracteres de todo Identificador de Entidad Jurídica (LEI)?
cross_lingual.new_answer: la unidad operativa local (LOU) que lo emitió

derived.prompt: Apple Inc. has a Legal Entity Identifier. What do the first four characters of Apple's LEI identify?
derived.new_answer: the Local Operating Unit that issued it
bridge: Apple Inc. has a Legal Entity Identifier.

derived.prompt: 213800ZBKL9QJBUPS454 is a Legal Entity Identifier. What does its prefix 2138 identify?
derived.new_answer: the Local Operating Unit that issued it

derived.prompt: A compliance tool must work out which organization issued a given LEI. Which characters of the code should it read?
Given only the first four characters of an LEI, can you tell which company the LEI belongs to?

unrelated_near.prompt: What does the abbreviation ISIN stand for?

notes: Source: ISO 17442 LEI structure as described by the LEI ROC, GLEIF partners and Wikipedia (characters 1-4 are the LOU prefix). A technical detail that models rarely hold.
